_doc: Per-model overrides for scripts/refresh/check_models.py. Keys match the 'model' field in api/v1/models.json. extra_urls are fetched IN ADDITION to the model's 'sources' and DO feed the change signature. news_query pulls Google News RSS for passive release/discontinuation signals — headlines land in news_headlines but NEVER feed the change signature (news churn would flag everything weekly). Pricing-aggregator URLs can be added per model under extra_urls at any time (public, no-key only). Entries are optional — models with no entry are checked using their models.json sources only. exclude_from_signature lists URL substrings that are fetched and recorded but excluded from change detection (verified-noisy rotating marketing pages).
